About Me

I specialize in helping faculty, staff, and students use learning technology more effectively.

My work sits at the intersection of LMS administration, instructional technology support, digital accessibility, course quality, and faculty training. I enjoy solving complex course-level issues, improving learning workflows, creating clear documentation, and helping instructors design more accessible and student-friendly learning experiences.

I currently support Moodle/OpenLMS environments, integrated instructional tools, accessibility initiatives, and faculty-facing training resources while completing graduate study in Educational Technology.
